name: Vascular Model Repository (VMR, SimVascular) - coronary CT cases
tier: T1/T2 (31 coronary CT/CTA cases with images: Kawasaki disease (mostly paediatric/young adult), CAD, saphenous vein grafts, 1 healthy). Also 40 aorta CT + 30 pulmonary CT/CT_MR projects (T2/T3).
n_scans: 31 coronary CT image volumes (1 per patient/project) with images included; 87 coronary projects total but 0249_*-0261_* CTCA CAD projects have Images=0 (models only). 119 CT projects with images across all anatomies.
est_size_gb: ~0.3-0.8 GB per project zip (images+models+meshes+simulations); ~15-25 GB for the 31 coronary projects (estimate from 3 Content-Length headers: 316 MB, 351 MB, 784 MB)
format: SimVascular project zip; image volume is VTK .vti (HU, spacing in cm); paths .pth, segmentations, models .vtp, meshes .vtu
labels: Vessel centreline paths, 2D lumen contours/segmentations, 3D surface models and CFD meshes/simulation results (coronary tree models, not voxel masks)
license: VMR licence: free for research and development purposes with copyright notice/acknowledgement (Stanford/UC/OSMSC 'All Rights Reserved... permission is hereby granted ... for research and development'); commercial use not explicitly granted; redistribution must include README-COPYRIGHT.
steps_to_access: Metadata: curl https://www.vascularmodel.com/dataset/dataset-svprojects.csv ; filter Anatomy=='Coronary' and Images=='1' and Image Modality in (CT,CTCA). Download each: curl -O https://www.vascularmodel.com/svprojects/<Name>.zip (e.g. 0066_H_CORO_H.zip). Image is <Name>/Images/*.vti; read with vtk.vtkXMLImageDataReader (spacing is in cm -> multiply by 10 for mm). No range requests supported (must download the whole zip).
provenance: Independent of ImageCAS/ASOCA. Sources: Cardiovascular Research Foundation of Southern California (13), UCSD (10+2, Kawasaki), Nippon Medical School Hospital (5), OSMSC (1). Some cases published in Sengupta/Marsden KD papers. Each project has an SDR DOI (Stanford Digital Repository).
verified: Read primary CSV metadata (316 projects). Downloaded 0066_H_CORO_H.zip (316 MB), extracted Images/OSMSC0002-cm.vti: 512x512x276, spacing 0.0387x0.0387x0.05 cm (0.39x0.39x0.5 mm), values -1024..1976, 99th pct 506 HU; viewed slices: contrast-enhanced cardiac CTA (left heart/aorta bright ~500 HU). File deleted. HEAD checks on 0075_H_CORO_CAD.zip (351 MB) and 0146_H_CORO_SVGD.zip (784 MB) returned 200.
notes: Small but genuinely new, open, independent cardiac CTA. Paediatric KD cases have aneurysmal coronaries - unusual anatomy for a 14-class model. Gating status per case not verified (most are coronary CTA by description).

name: HOCMvalvesSeg (Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, Xu lab)
tier: T2 (cardiac CTA for HOCM surgical planning; Siemens SOMATOM Definition Flash; coronaries visible)
format: NIfTI (.nii, uncompressed). WARNING: images are uint8 (0-255, already windowed) and header spacing is 1x1x1 mm, not HU / native spacing (description says 0.25x0.25x0.5 mm)
labels: AV, MV, aorta, LA, LV, myocardium, excised myocardium
steps_to_access: No account needed for single files: curl -L -o 17_image.nii https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg/17_image.nii ; whole set: https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg (302 to signed GCS URL). Paper: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v222/zheng24a/zheng24a.pdf
provenance: Same hospital (GPPH) as ImageCAS but a distinct HOCM surgical cohort (ages 38-76); overlap with ImageCAS not excluded by authors but unlikely.
verified: Read Kaggle API metadata + file list; downloaded 17_image.nii (99 MB): 512x512x378 uint8 0-255, viewed slices = contrast cardiac CTA (bright LV/aorta). Deleted.
notes: Usable for visual annotation but not for HU-based work; ask authors ([contact removed]) for raw HU if needed.

name: ImageCHD (congenital heart disease CT, MICCAI 2020)
tier: T2 (congenital heart CTA, Siemens Flash, ages 1 month-40 y; coronaries visible but small)
format: NIfTI in a split zip (ImageCHD_dataset.z01..z1x + .change2zip -> rename to .zip, then 7z x)
labels: LV, RV, LA, RA, myocardium, aorta, pulmonary artery (+ extra labels to ignore); CHD diagnosis xlsx (16 CHD types)
steps_to_access: curl -L -o imagechd.zip https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/imagechd (no login needed in test of the endpoint), unzip, rename ImageCHD_dataset.change2zip -> .zip and extract the multi-part archive with 7z.
provenance: GPPH (Guangdong); independent congenital cohort, not ImageCAS. CHD68 (MICCAI 2019) by the same group very likely overlaps.
verified: Kaggle API metadata and 13-file list read; not downloaded (split archive > 2 GB disk budget).
notes: Paediatric anatomy, not typical adult CCTA.

name: CHD68 whole-heart & great-vessel segmentation (MICCAI 2019)
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Kaggle); original Box copy required password from [contact removed]
steps_to_access: https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/chd68-segmentation-dataset-miccai19
provenance: Same group/hospital as ImageCHD; probably a subset of ImageCHD's 110 (unverified) - treat as duplicate until checked.

name: ImageALCAPA (anomalous left coronary artery from pulmonary artery, BIBM 2022)
tier: T2 (pre-operative ALCAPA CTA, Siemens Flash; coronary anomaly)
labels: Myo, LV, RV, PA, Ao, LCA, RCA

provenance: GPPH 2016-2021; independent of ImageCAS (paediatric ALCAPA).
verified: Kaggle metadata + file list; not downloaded (2.6 GB > 2 GB budget).
notes: Has LCA/RCA labels - useful edge cases for coronary origin anomalies.

name: Kaggle 'Coronary Artery Diseases Random Samples' (younesselbrag)
tier: T1 (verified ECG-gated coronary CTA: StudyDescription 'CT ANGIO-CORONARY ARTERIES', Philips iCT 256, 40% phase)
license: CC0 claimed by uploader; provenance and consent undocumented ('Unofficial Structured Cases')
steps_to_access: Whole: curl -L -o cad.zip https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/younesselbrag/cases-coronaries-altries-diseases-cases-ct ; single file: .../download/younesselbrag/cases-coronaries-altries-diseases-cases-ct/<url-encoded path>
provenance: Unknown institution (InstitutionName 'Erased'); study dates 2022; not ImageCAS (Philips vs Siemens). Cases 1-55 not published.
verified: Paged full file list via Kaggle API; downloaded one DICOM (IMG100, case56): CT, Philips iCT 256, Coronary CTA protocol, Iodine, 0.9 mm, 99th pct 518 HU, viewed slice = contrast CCTA. Deleted.
notes: Not a literature dataset (found while checking Kaggle mirrors); legal provenance is the risk - check with project lead before sharing labels on it.

name: ASOCA (Automated Segmentation Of Coronary Arteries, MICCAI 2020) / Sci Data 2023 descriptor
n_scans: 60 patients (40 train: 20 normal + 20 diseased, with labels; 20 test: 10+10). UKDS record covers 20 normal + 20 diseased (the labelled 40).
format: NRRD images + NRRD labels, centrelines, meshes
labels: Voxel lumen (3-expert majority vote), centrelines, calcium scores, lumen meshes
license: UKDS: 'All requests subject to permission of the data owner'; ASOCA citation policy. Kaggle mirrors (ayushsri2004/asoca-data, ayuuushsri/asoca-dataset) are unauthorised re-uploads - do not rely on them.
steps_to_access: Email [contact removed] (ASOCA DAC, UNSW) stating purpose; then register at UK Data Service and request via Access Helpdesk; challenge page also mentions a temporary alternative request form. Expected wait: days-weeks.
provenance: Coronary Atlas project, Auckland City Hospital, NZ (2017-2020). Independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Read grand-challenge home page and UKDS record (files ASOCA_Normal.zip etc. 'Closed access ... permission from depositor').
notes: Small but high-quality, also widely used as external test set. 14-class labels must be made by annotators.

name: MM-WHS 2017 (Multi-Modality Whole Heart Segmentation) - CT part
tier: T2 (cardiac CT/CTA; many are coronary CTA protocol)
license: Data access agreement: recipient may not disseminate data to third parties; cite Zhuang papers.
steps_to_access: Sign the registration form (res/Data_Access_Agreement_for_Participants.pdf on the site), send to organisers, then download via the MEGA link on the page. Site notes 'maintenance of MMWHS has ended - see CARE' (WHS++).
provenance: Shanghai hospitals (Philips 64-slice + others). Independent of ImageCAS. Many Kaggle mirrors exist (unauthorised).
verified: Read primary page; did not sign/download.
notes: Superseded by WHS++ (CARE 2024) which appears to include more CT.

name: WHS++ (CARE 2024, MICCAI) whole-heart segmentation - CT part
tier: T2/T1 ('cardiac CT/CTA acquired using standard coronary CT angiography protocols')
n_scans: 104 CT (plus 102 MRI) from 2 CT centres; released: 40 train + 30 validation CT (34 CT test withheld)
license: Agreement PDF required (CARE registration); terms not read
steps_to_access: Register at http://zmic.org.cn/care_2024/eval/register?track=WHS%2B%2B and upload signed registration form named Agreement_(Track)_<Username>.pdf; contact [contact removed] / [contact removed].
provenance: Likely a superset of MM-WHS CT (Centre A Philips 64-slice; Centre B Siemens dual-source / GE). Dedupe against MM-WHS.
verified: Read track page (data overview, split, acquisition).
notes: Probably ~44 CT beyond MM-WHS; unverified.

name: MultiD4CAD (Sci Data 2025)
tier: T1 (ECG-gated CCTA, Siemens SOMATOM Definition AS+ 128, Palermo)
n_scans: 118 patients (40 no-CAD, 78 CAD); 1 CCTA series each (+ calcium-score scan not stated as included)
est_size_gb: unknown (catalog lists '4.0 TB' which looks like an error)
labels: Epicardial and pericoronary adipose tissue masks; clinical CSV
steps_to_access: 1) Create Zenodo account with public username/email; 2) sign DUA (Zenodo 15063937) and email it with subject 'MultiD4CAD Request access' to the contact in the DUA; 3) request access on the Zenodo record giving name/affiliation/email; granted within ~2 working days.
provenance: University Hospital Policlinico 'P. Giaccone', Palermo; independent new scans.
verified: Read paper full text (Europe PMC) and Zenodo API record (restricted).
notes: Paper states the dataset contains 'the original CCTA series' - good T1 source.

name: Multicenter CCTA report-generation benchmark (CSM_CCTA, arXiv 2609.00909)
n_scans: 818 patients / 3,021 CCTA series (PUMCH 567, Tianjin Chest 105, Beijing Shijitan 49, First Affil. Xinjiang 97) with paired reports
steps_to_access: README 'Benchmark Access': email [contact removed] (Pengcheng Laboratory / SIAT).
provenance: 4 Chinese hospitals, independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Read arXiv HTML (Dataset section) and OpenI repo README.
notes: Largest new-scan lead found in the literature; worth a request letter.

name: Coronary Atlas (UNSW Sydney Vascular Modelling Group / Auckland)
n_scans: 'largest coronary population shape database' - size not stated (Medrano-Gracia 2016 atlas used ~300 normal CTCA; unverified)

steps_to_access: Contact Dr Susann Beier, [contact removed], with ethics approval/waiver for the project.
provenance: Auckland City Hospital CTCA; ASOCA is a 40-60 case subset.
verified: Read UNSW project page; UNSWorks metadata via search snippet.
notes: Potentially hundreds of CTCA beyond ASOCA.

name: AAOCA cohorts (Bern/Zurich, Nat Commun 2025)
n_scans: Bern + Zurich CCTA cohorts with anomalous aortic origin of coronary arteries (counts in paper; not extracted)
license: Restricted (IRB + Data Sharing Committee approvals at Bern, Zurich and requester)
steps_to_access: Contact Dr Christoph Gräni (Inselspital Bern, AI-CVI lab); approvals 'within a time frame of one year'.
provenance: Swiss hospitals; 'public' dataset cited in paper is TotalSegmentator (zenodo 6802614) and ImageCAS, not new.

notes: Slow (≤1 year).

name: TUM coronary plaque CCTA cohort (PLoS One 2026)

provenance: Single centre, Germany.
verified: Read data availability statement and GitHub README.
notes: Not practical for remote annotation.
